## Où j'en suis
The SRE take-home is ready in its own private repo: a 3-hour Compose/Terraform exercise with no Kubernetes, a flawed alert, a connection leak, and an over-broad IAM policy. The rubric has four scored areas with no cutoff; the panel decides. The `hiring/` directory was removed from the infra branch’s working tree, and no PR was opened there.

- [en-cours] The infra-branch removal is uncommitted; the branch is to be dropped later.
- [prochaine-étape] Hold the Thursday call, then invite the candidate and send the exercise yourself.
- [décision] Keep the exercise to Terraform and Compose only, with a 3-hour maximum (source: t03)
- [décision] Scores are input for the panel, not a cutoff; Noa is the second reviewer (source: t10)
- [décision] Keep the exercise in its own private repo and do not open an infra PR (source: t14)
- [décision] Do not email anyone; send the exercise yourself after the call (source: t16)
